title: Habit Domino-Effect Map
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=correlation:pair
| where abs(correlation)>0.4
| stats values(driver) as drivers by outcome
| sort outcome
description: Maps how your habits cascade — good sleep to more exercise to better mood — showing the keystone ones.
value: Finding the keystone habit that pulls the others along tells you where a single change has the biggest ripple.
implementation: Compute pairwise habit correlations in `index=personal`; group strong links by outcome.
visualization: Network view of linked habits and outcomes.
grandmaExplanation: It maps how your habits knock into each other, showing the one keystone change that improves everything.
